text: player
In Bamboo Cloud's attic, I stand at the door to Fuuka Minami's private lounge, recalling my conversation with Ume.
The boss wants to see me at this hour? Should I be worried?
Ume
Perhaps she's pleased with your work and wants to have a chat with you.
Don't overthink it. Being invited for a chat isn't necessarily a bad thing.
Is there anything I should watch out for?
Nothing beyond the usual. Well, actually... there is something you should keep in mind.
Ms. Fuuka was in a good mood today and had a bit too much to drink. If she tries anything, don't let her take it too far.
I... can say "no" to the boss?
Of course you can, hehe. Middle managers must learn not only downward management... but upward management as well.
Learning when to rebuff unreasonable demands from the boss is just one more workplace lesson for you to learn.
Now go. Don't keep Ms. Fuuka waiting.
"Knock, knock..." I rap at the door and realize that it's open.
Fuuka Minami
Come in.
The room is bathed in a warm, yellow light. Draped over a chaise longue by the window, Fuuka Minami gives me a cursory wave when she sees me come in.
Have a seat.
Boss...
Drink?
Before I can respond, she sits up and slides a cup of wine over to me. The clear liquid inside smells faintly of osmanthus.
Accept
Decline
Oh, sure.
Bottoms up.
Remember Ume's advice about "upward management."
Sorry, Boss, but I'm not much of a drinker.
What? That's a serious problem in business. But that's fine, I can teach you.
She sits up and leans in until the wine cup held between her slender fingers stops right in front of me.
Well? Aren't you going to take it? Or did you want me to pour it into your mouth myself?
Her voice drops, as if she's slightly displeased.
Stand your ground
Sensing that my boss is about to get angry, I have no choice but to drink.
"Upward management... Upward management... Upward management..." Repeating this mantra to myself in my head, I hold firm.
I'm serious, Ms. Fuuka. I don't drink.
Hehe, well done.
I can't believe you didn't budge an inch.
That was unnecessary...
Sitting right down next to me, Fuuka gets me into a chokehold with one arm and raises the cup to my lips with her other hand.
Now that I'm giving you a helping hand, you should be able to drink... right?
My mission is before me, and my boss' orders mixed with threats are in my ear.
Adamantly refuse!
I accept my fate. I reach out, take the cup, and down its contents.
Please, Ume! Save me in my time of need!
I'm serious, Boss! I don't drink.
(whisper) Tch, you're no fun.
Her enthusiasm perhaps worn down at last by my firm resolve, she gives up on trying to make me drink. She leans against me with a sigh and twiddles the cup between her fingers.
The vague fragrance next to me mixed with the pungent smell of the wine is practically giving me second-hand intoxication.
Um... How much have you had to drink?
Hm... A little? No, wait... maybe a little more than a little.
Boss, are you... drunk?
Me? Maybe a little. But I can still remember who you are and that I had Ume send you here, so relax.
When she tilts her head to the side, Fuuka's face flushes reddish--. Looks like she's more than just "a little" drunk.
Right! I asked you to come... and you came.

She stands up and walks over to the open window. The moon shines brightly in the sky while the lights below shimmer in the darkness. I know that those lights are from Bamboo Cloud's celebration, where they're shining on countless smiling faces.
What do you see?
Bamboo Cloud's celebration... It's so grand and lively.
And?
Uh... The bustling Champion Street.
And in the distance?
Well... it looks dark and cold compared to where the festivities are.
That's why... we must let the lights stretch out from Champion Street until they fill all of One Han City.
And from One Han City, they will light paths to every single place.
Fuuka turns her head to look at me. I don't know if it's the drunken haze or the warm light, but some of her queenly demeanor has fallen away to reveal more of a gentle side than usual.
The celebration was a success. Your contributions are undeniable.
The truth is, I didn't expect you to ace so many tasks in such a short amount of time.
In the end, we didn't even need the five or six backup plans I had Ume prepare for you. Hehe.
Honestly, that's mainly because everyone else has done such a good job. I just tried to keep apace.
And you know how to charm people with sweet talk. Well, I hope you'll keep up the good work, my new secretary.
Relax.
She reaches out and clasps my shoulders firmly with both hands.
One day, you'll have your place in Bamboo Cloud too.

Her face lights up when she says this. I look in the direction she pointed just now, then further into the distance... A glimmer of hope also sparks in my heart--If it's Fuuka, I may not have to wait too long.
The fiery liquid runs down my throat and into my stomach, and my vision begins to blur.
Whoops! I forgot to say, this wine is called "broken osmanthus branch," and it's quite strong.
And you just gulped it all down, tsk tsk...
Lemme see...
Fuuka Minami sways back and forth before my eyes... Finally, I can't suppress the intoxication any longer, and everything goes dark.
Upward management... unsuccessful...
